next.reason: A 1985 CONTINUE has no AFTER phrase, and 'If the AFTER phrase is not specified, then the statement is processed as if an AFTER phrase were specified with arithmetic-expression-1 specified as zero' (§2023:14.9.9.3 SR2). Zero is not negative, so no EC-CONTINUE condition arises, and after a zero suspension 'When the time is passed, execution continues with the next executable statement' (§2023:14.9.9.4 GR1). That is no effect, as in 1985. Suspension needs the AFTER phrase, which 1985 lacks.
